♦️ **UA PUKA MAI KA FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, ʻo AutoCaptions me **Your script** a me **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, a ʻo **Flex Studio (Beta)** e hoʻoiho mua ana a nīnau mai ma mua o ka hoʻouka ʻana.

*(E hoʻouka ma luna o kāu mana o kēia manawa a e hoʻomaka hou iā After Effects i hoʻokahi manawa.)*

♦️ **Hou: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Ka hoʻonohonoho **Map desk**, ka huli wahi me ka pūnaewele ʻole, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route a me nā mea hou aku), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, nā kaila palapala ʻāina manuahi a me **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Ke hoʻouka maoli ʻia nei kāna mau mea hana ʻē aʻe (ka hoʻonohonoho like ola, nā kaila, nā lepili, 3D, Finalize) i loko o After Effects.

♦️ **Nā mea hou ma AutoCaptions**
* ʻO **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (ma ke ao, hoʻohana i nā credits Flex AI) ka mīkini i paipai ʻia, ua koho ʻia i hoʻokahi manawa no nā mea a pau. E koho hou iā Whisper no ka hana manuahi ʻana i nā huaʻōlelo hōʻike ma kāu kamepiula (pono ʻo Translate To iā Whisper). Inā paʻahana ke kikowaena, hōʻike ʻia kou wahi ma ka laina.
* **Your script**: lawe nā huaʻōlelo hōʻike i ka pela ʻana a me nā huaʻōlelo o kāu palapala ma nā wahi a pau āu i ʻōlelo ai i ia mau huaʻōlelo.
* Hopena **Editable template**: nā huaʻōlelo hōʻike ma ke ʻano he mau papa template e hoʻololi ai ʻoe i ke kaila ma Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* ʻAʻohe mea i koho ʻia a hakahaka ʻo Source media? Hāʻawi ʻo ia i ka **composition holoʻokoʻa**. Hoʻohana hou ka leo like i kona kope ʻōlelo.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* Hoʻoiho mua ʻo **Download Flex Studio (Beta)**, a laila nīnau ʻo ia **Install / Not now**.
* Ka polokalamu (2.0.0-beta.2): nā wahi hana **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, nā pihi mea hana o After Effects, wehe koke nā clip, a hana ʻo OPEN ma nā precomp a me nā papa hoʻoponopono.

♦️ **Ua hoʻoponopono ʻia**
* Ua hoʻi mai nā hopena kumuhana i nalo ma nā PC Windows he nui (māmā aʻe ke pio nā hopena hoʻoneʻe o Windows).

♦️ **Wahi koho no ka pale laikini**
* Nīnau ʻia i hoʻokahi manawa, he koho wale nō: me **No thanks**, hana mau nā mea a pau. E hoʻololi ma **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Mālama ʻia no 12 mahina, ʻaʻole loa e kūʻai ʻia aku, ʻaʻole loa e kaʻana ʻia koe wale nō ke koi ke kānāwai.

ult.message:
♦️ **UA PUKA MAI KA FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Ke neʻe nei ʻo Caption Stack i loko o AutoCaptions** me nā kaila, nā hoʻonohonoho, ka neʻe ʻana a me nā kani no kēlā me kēia huaʻōlelo. Hana ʻo **UN-NEST** a me nā ʻano hoʻohui ma Premiere 26.5, hoʻokahi kaomi wale nō ʻo **AUTO CUT**, a wehe ʻo **Flex Studio (Beta)** i kāu clip mai ka papa mana mai.

*(E hoʻouka ma luna o kāu mana o kēia manawa a e hoʻomaka hou iā Premiere Pro i hoʻokahi manawa.)*

♦️ **Hou: Nā huaʻōlelo hōʻike neʻe ma AutoCaptions**
* **Kaila huaʻōlelo**: e hāʻawi i kēlā me kēia huaʻōlelo i kona mau waihoʻoluʻu ponoʻī, kona font a me ka hoʻopau Flat, Shine a i ʻole Glow.
* **Nā hoʻonohonoho laina**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside a me Line.
* **Ka neʻe no kēlā me kēia huaʻōlelo** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake a me nā mea hou aku) me ka nānā mua, a me nā kani **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Pono nā kaila huaʻōlelo a me ka neʻe i ka hopena **Images**.
* ʻO **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (ma ke ao, hoʻohana i nā credits Flex AI) ka mīkini i paipai ʻia i kēia manawa, ua koho ʻia i hoʻokahi manawa no nā mea a pau; e koho i kekahi mīkini Whisper no ka hana manuahi ʻana me ka pūnaewele ʻole.
* **Your script** (ke ʻano Captions): lawe nā huaʻōlelo hōʻike i nā huaʻōlelo o kāu palapala ma nā wahi āu i ʻōlelo ai i ia mau huaʻōlelo.
* Inā ʻaʻohe mea i koho ʻia (hakahaka ke kāleka Source), hāʻawi ʻo ia i ka **timeline holoʻokoʻa**; mālama ʻia nā huaʻōlelo hōʻike ma ka ʻaoʻao o kāu papahana.

♦️ **Hou: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* Hahai ʻo **Open in Flex Studio** i ka clip ma ka polokalamu; hoʻihoʻi ʻo **APPLY TO PREMIERE** i ka track. ʻAʻole i hoʻouka ʻia? Hoʻoiho ʻo **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** iā ia, a laila nīnau ʻo ia **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Ua loli**
* Kālailai ʻo **AUTO CUT** i kekahi clip i koho ʻia a ʻoki me hoʻokahi kaomi. Hopu ʻo **Retakes** i nā laina i hoʻomaka hou ʻia.
* Eono mau ʻaoʻao liʻiliʻi ko **Audio Studio** i kēia manawa. Aia ka **Library** ma Nest Saver.

♦️ **Ua hoʻoponopono ʻia**
* ʻO **UN-NEST** ma Premiere 26.5 (ua hōʻole i kēlā me kēia nest), a me nā ʻano hoʻohui e like me Screen i hoʻi hou i Normal (Premiere ma ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia).
* Ka chip ʻulaʻula **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, ka nānā mua ʻeleʻele o Caption Stack, a me nā hopena kumuhana i nalo ma nā PC Windows he nui.

♦️ **Wahi koho no ka pale laikini**
* Nīnau ʻia i hoʻokahi manawa, he koho wale nō: me **No thanks**, hana mau nā mea a pau. E hoʻololi ma **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Mālama ʻia no 12 mahina, ʻaʻole loa e kūʻai ʻia aku, ʻaʻole loa e kaʻana ʻia koe wale nō ke koi ke kānāwai.
